take_homes: The AI fills gaps with generic plausible text, and it goes easy on its own work, so I have to check it against what I know.
What I learn can be written into a rules file that a fresh agent reads, so it does not start from zero. I should read that file, not the chat summary.
Changing the context changes the output, and I can try that on my own work in an afternoon.

misconception.why: The module said what does not work: the tool fills gaps with generic filler and flatters its own output. I could check that myself. That is not what the earlier programmes did. I still think much of the surrounding material is the same old content, so I am not converted, but 'wait and see' now looks less safe.

one_line: Strip out the repeated filler paragraphs and the middle is a useful hour: it says the tool flatters itself, and you can check that yourself.
